name: cyna
description: Syntax highlighting and editor support for the current Cyna language surface.

cyna.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable Cyna diagnostics by running the compiler on open and save.

cyna.diagnostics.validateOnChange.description: Run diagnostics while editing. By default diagnostics run on open and save to avoid checking stale on-disk content.

cyna.compiler.command.description: Compiler command for diagnostics. Leave empty to use cyna.

cyna.compiler.args.description: Compiler arguments for diagnostics. Use ${file} for the current file. Leave empty to use check ${file}.

cyna.compiler.cwd.description: Working directory for compiler diagnostics. Supports absolute paths, workspace-relative paths, and ${workspaceFolder}, ${file}, ${fileDirname}.

cyna.lsp.command.description: Command used to launch the Cyna language server. Leave empty to use cyna.

cyna.lsp.args.description: Arguments used to launch the Cyna language server. Leave empty to use lsp.

cyna.lsp.cwd.description: Working directory for the Cyna language server. Supports absolute paths, workspace-relative paths, and ${workspaceFolder}.
